recipes.name: Iron Mace
recipes.description: A solid iron mace forged from raw ore. Reliable blunt-force weapon capable of stunning enemies.

recipes.name: Heavy War Mace
recipes.description: A reinforced war mace incorporating salvaged orc steel and hardened hide grip. Superior impact force.

recipes.name: Spiked Morningstar
recipes.description: A brutal spiked morningstar forged from the finest orcish steel. Devastating stun potential.

recipes.name: Iron Longsword
recipes.description: A versatile one-handed iron longsword, balanced for both standalone striking and pairing with a shield or offhand blade.

recipes.name: Two-Handed Longsword
recipes.description: A heavy two-handed longsword demanding both hands on the hilt. Deals heavy impact damage at the expense of offhand flexibility.

recipes.name: Iron Spear
recipes.description: A versatile one-handed spear with a forged iron tip, ideal for pairing with a shield.

recipes.name: Two-Handed Spear
recipes.description: A heavy two-handed spear with a long ash shaft and reinforced blade. Delivers heavy piercing damage at the cost of offhand defense.

recipes.name: Forged Katana
recipes.description: A curved single-edged blade folded from refined iron. Balanced for swift cuts and rapid recovery.

recipes.name: Iron Throwing Knives
recipes.description: A balanced set of iron throwing knives forged from raw ore and timber grips. Fast ranged skirmishing weapon.

recipes.name: Arbalest Crossbow
recipes.description: A heavy mechanical arbalest with a forged iron prod, steel trigger mechanism, and seasoned timber stock.

recipes.name: Lockpick
recipes.description: A slender pick fashioned from malleable iron ore wire. Essential tool required to pick Locked Boxes.

recipes.name: Fishing Rod
recipes.description: A flexible rod shaped from seasoned timber and strung with a salvaged bowstring. Essential tool required for fishing in subterranean waters.

recipes.name: Smelt Broken Lockbox
recipes.description: Smelt a ruined lockbox in the forge to reclaim 2 Steel Scrap.

recipes.name: Iron Shield
recipes.description: A sturdy iron-rimmed wooden shield capable of deflecting and blocking enemy blows.

recipes.name: Iron Shortsword
recipes.description: A nimble iron blade suited for rapid thrusts and close-quarters melee combat.

recipes.name: Steel Greatsword
recipes.description: A massive two-handed greatsword forged from heavy iron, seasoned timber, and reinforced with salvaged steel scrap for devastating crushing blows.

recipes.name: Iron Daggers
recipes.description: A pair of lightweight iron daggers designed for rapid stabbing strikes.

recipes.name: Steel Short Sword
recipes.description: A razor-honed steel short sword reinforced with salvaged steel. Fast, lethal, and causes grievous bleeding.

recipes.name: Steel Longsword
recipes.description: A masterfully balanced one-handed steel longsword forged with folded steel plates.

recipes.name: Folded Steel Katana
recipes.description: A deadly curved blade folded repeatedly from refined steel. Inflicts severe bleeding wounds.

recipes.name: Steel Spear
recipes.description: A formidable one-handed spear tipped with a heavy steel pike point, balanced for shield fighting.

recipes.name: Steel Halberd
recipes.description: A heavy polearm mounting a broad axe blade and armor-piercing steel spike for devastating two-handed cleaves.

recipes.name: Serrated Daggers
recipes.description: Twin steel daggers quenched in spider venom with cruel serrated edges that shred flesh.

recipes.name: Heavy Crossbow
recipes.description: A high-tension mechanical crossbow with reinforced steel limbs delivering heavy kinetic penetration.

recipes.name: Steel Kite Shield
recipes.description: A tapered kite shield forged from layered steel plates, offering superior deflection and damage mitigation.

recipes.name: Steel Chakrams
recipes.description: Aerodynamic circular throwing blades ground to razor sharpness. Fast and sidearm-compatible.

recipes.name: Voidforged Short Sword
recipes.description: A swift short sword forged from planar void plate. Swift, deep strikes produce catastrophic bleed.

recipes.name: Voidforged Longsword
recipes.description: A legendary one-handed blade radiating void resonance. Cuts through enemy armor with effortless power.

recipes.name: Voidforged Katana
recipes.description: A masterwork katana folded from void metal. Each lightning-fast draw opens deep planar lacerations.

recipes.name: Voidforged Greatsword
recipes.description: A colossal two-handed greatsword forged from dense void plate. Delivers cataclysmic impact damage.

recipes.name: Voidforged Spear
recipes.description: A sleek one-handed void spear capable of impaling foes with immense piercing force behind a shield.

recipes.name: Voidforged Halberd
recipes.description: A titanic two-handed void halberd whose massive cleaving blade disrupts reality with each swing.

recipes.name: Voidforged Daggers
recipes.description: Pair of void assassin daggers that blur through the shadows, opening vicious bleeding wounds.

recipes.name: Voidforged Crossbow
recipes.description: A pinnacle siege crossbow radiating void energy, launching heavy quarrels at extreme range.

recipes.name: Voidforged Tower Shield
recipes.description: An impenetrable tower shield hammered from void plate, neutralizing blows and absorbing punishment.

recipes.name: Voidforged Throwing Blades
recipes.description: Balanced throwing discs honed from void metal that curve through the air with unerring precision.
